My new book, The Case For America: An Argument On Behalf Of Our Nation, is available in THREE DAYS! You can pre-order the book {including a signed copy} today or pick it up Tuesday wherever books are sold. Please visit thecaseforamerica.com for more information and while you’re there be sure and record your #caseforamerica! #america250 #america #american #books

Good morning! I will be in Palm Beach next Friday, May 8th @RaptisRareBooks! I hope to see you there to sign your copy of #TheCaseForAmerica!

Hey #PalmBeach! I’ll be @raptisrarebooks next Friday, May 8th at 7:30pm to sign your copy of #TheCaseForAmerica — I hope to see you there! #America250 #author #booksigning

How would bestselling author and happiness expert @arthurbrooks make his #CaseForAmerica? Head over to thecaseforamerica.com to make YOUR “Case For America” today and learn how you can pre-order my new book out May 5th. #foxnews #thecaseforamerica #america250

Video
This year’s Kentucky Derby is a sweet family affair as legendary trainer Bill Mott faces off against his son, Riley 🐎❤️
FBI Director Kash Patel announced charges against four non-citizens accused of illegally voting in multiple federal elections #breakingnews #fbi #news #specialreport
Ari Fleischer discusses the new Republican-led reconciliation package aimed at funding DHS, Border Patrol, and I.C.E. #specialreport #panel
After a six-year hiatus, U.S. passenger air service to Venezuelanofficially resumed today as the first American Airlines flight departed Miami for Caracas #specialreport #venezuela

Today I got to join the @willcainshow and broke down why the Suprene Court redistricting ruling is a “huge deal” — and how simple shift in lines could trigger a massive political wave for years to come.

Big thanks to @Lawrence Jones @Bill Hemmer @Sean Hannity and everyone else in our @Fox News family who made their cases for America! Be sure to pre-order your book today and make your case to win a free signed copy by checking out thecaseforamerica.com (link in bio) #caseforamerica #book #america250

@General Motors CEO Mary Barra joined me tonight and shared some of her thoughts on aligning with President Trumps manufacturing goals while navigating “commodity pressure” and rising logistics costs caused by the ongoing Iran conflict. #specialreport #generalmotors
Be sure to tune in tonight to see my exclusive interview with @General Motors CEO Mary Barra tonight at 6PM ET on #specialreport #generalmotors

On tonight’s Common Ground I was joined by Jason Smith and Jimmy Panera to discuss their historic bipartisan partnership with First Lady Melania Trump to overhaul the U.S. foster care system #commonground #bipartisan #fostercare

Condoleezza Rice shared her case for America! Be sure to share yours today at thecaseforamerica.com (link in bio) for a chance to win a signed copy of 'The Case For America'.  #book #america250 #caseforamerica
